sources.entry: TrailBase - Open, sub-millisecond, single-executable FireBase alternative with type-safe REST & realtime APIs, built-in JS/TS runtime, auth & admin UI. (Demo, Source Code) OSL-3.0 Rust/Docker

summary.one_liner: TrailBase is a single-executable, self-hostable Firebase alternative providing type-safe REST and realtime APIs, auth, and an admin UI, built on Rust, Wasmtime and SQLite.
summary.what_it_does: TrailBase ships as one executable that serves type-safe REST and realtime APIs backed by SQLite (Postgres is listed as experimental). The README describes a built-in WebAssembly runtime for custom server-side logic, geospatial support, SSR, authentication, and an admin dashboard. Pre-built binaries are provided for Linux, macOS and Windows, and a Docker image is available. Client libraries are listed for JavaScript/TypeScript, Dart/Flutter, Rust, C#/.NET, Swift, Kotlin, Go and Python. An optional auth UI can be added as a WASM component via the trail CLI.
use_cases: self-host a backend for a mobile app
Firebase alternative for web or desktop apps
realtime data sync for client applications
REST API over a SQLite database
admin dashboard for managing app data and users
server-side custom logic with WebAssembly or JS/TS
how_to_run: curl -sSL | bash  (Linux & macOS quick install; URL missing from README text)
trail run  (starts the server on localhost:4000)
trail components add trailbase/auth_ui  (optional auth UI)
git submodule update --init --recursive && pnpm install && cargo build --bin trail  (build from source)
notable: Single executable with no external runtime dependencies to deploy
Built-in WebAssembly runtime for custom server-side logic
Claims sub-millisecond latencies, removing the need for a separate cache
Client libraries for eight language ecosystems
Client libraries dual-licensed Apache-2.0; server under OSL-3.0
caveats: Building from source requires Rust, Node.js, GEOS, protobuf and pnpm, plus git submodules
Contributions beyond bug fixes require prior discussion and a CLA
